A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same DCT research. Their main text, equations, figures, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material across appendix reordering.

before.justification: v4 reports original simulations of CI-test errors, synthetic causal-discovery experiments, and a Big Five Personality data analysis in Section 4 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v5 retains these original empirical results in Section 4 and Appendix H, including the supplementary robustness experiments and personality-data analysis.

M1.justification: Theorem 3.8 replaces the published CI variance weights with a signed, vectorized expression, changing the stated inference calculation. Binarization, bridge-equation covariance estimation, and the nodewise statistic remain unchanged. The PDFs do not establish an implementation change or experimental rerun.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same synthetic Gaussian, non-Gaussian, nonlinear, dense-graph, and nonstandard mean/variance scenarios, plus the same Big Five Personality variables. Appendix E's experiments move to Appendix H.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Fisher-Z and Chi-square remain in their corresponding comparisons, with Fisherz_nodis retained as the continuous-data reference in the main synthetic causal-discovery experiments.

E3.justification: Reported sample sizes, discretization levels, conditioning-set sizes, graph settings, significance levels, Type II error calibration, orientation procedures, and evaluation metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: The same analyses examine distributional-assumption violations, graph density, nonzero means/non-unit variances, and the personality-data case study. Their relocation from Appendix E to H introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: Theorem 3.8 and Appendix B.8.2 revise the analytical variance weights used for DCT significance testing. Experimental uncertainty reporting remains unchanged, including 1,500 test repetitions and 10 seeded graph instances with mean and standard-deviation reporting.

E6.justification: Figures 2–9 retain identical experimental content, including error curves, causal-discovery scores, uncertainty bars, and personality graphs. The supplementary experimental text is also unchanged after matching section labels and citation formatting.

T1.justification: Theorem 2.1 adds a mutual-dependence assumption, and Equation 1 removes the first bin's restriction to positive transformed values. Theorem 3.8 and Appendix B.8.2 revise the variance coefficient and expand its vectorization derivation. These are localized revisions to existing theory.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same central claims: recovering latent CI from discretized observations, handling continuous/discrete/mixed pairs, deriving asymptotic tests, and demonstrating empirical effectiveness.

C2.justification: Section 4.2 removes the explicit qualification that performance declines with more variables and smaller samples. The broader discussions of binarization-related information loss, Gaussian assumptions, and robustness remain.

D1.justification: The code-access link, pseudocode workflow, experimental implementation disclosures, CPU specification, processor count, and runtime statement are retained. Relocating Resource Usage does not change reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The cited-work set and research positioning are unchanged, including the distinction from Fan et al. (2017). Related Work moves from Appendix F to E; reference changes are formatting edits.

P1.justification: v5 copyedits the abstract and methodological exposition, standardizes variable/sample indices, and adds explanatory detail. Related work, resources, and limitations now precede supplementary experiments, while the main narrative structure is retained.

P2.justification: v5 adds the ICLR publication header, adjusts the notation table and equation layout, and relocates appendix figures, including placing Figure 9 on a separate final page. No figures are added or redrawn.

improvement.justification: The dependence qualification in Theorem 2.1, repaired bin definition, and expanded variance derivation improve mathematical specificity and checkability. Gains are limited: empirical evidence is unchanged, Section 4.2 loses a useful performance caveat, and the added Appendix B.8.2 algebra still inconsistently uses vec(vw^T) versus vec(uw^T).
